note: A name is the join key between a batch entry, its dense colormap and its provenance row, so two maps cannot share one. Where a run emitted a name another map already held, the map ships under a new name and the emitted one is kept here. The names to clear are the ones in this drop, the ones in the shipped library, and the ones in the source project's pooled library — a name held there is a different gradient a corpus row may still resolve through `library_import`, which is why `tests/test_library_import.py` compares by name. Batch files are exactly as the generator wrote them; this is the only place a name was changed.
